thoughts: Right now I'm in CHOP mode: Bitcoin is below its 200-day average, which means the market is directionless — chasing momentum here loses money, so instead I look for a coin that fell unusually hard and try to catch its bounce back. That's why I'm holding XRP. I keep my seat through small wobbles instead of paying fees on every flicker.

strategy.name: Regime Switcher — two brains, one bot
strategy.rule: BTC above its 200-day MA = TREND: ride the hottest rising 7-day-momentum coin. Below = CHOP: buy the most oversold coin (z20 < -1.25) and harvest the bounce; nothing qualifies -> cash. Exits use a dead-band (hold until mom < -2% / z back to -0.25) so boundary wobbles don't churn fees
